verdict_summary: Intangible-adjusted value does NOT escape the KR large-cap wall. Standard value death (AX-003) reproduced; intangible adjustment barely re-ranks (cross-rank Spearman 0.987), does not tilt value large-cap (signal~size -0.705), and forcing a large-cap/intangible tilt makes post-2017 cap-w PORT_t strictly worse. KR value death is real, not an intangible-mismeasurement artifact.

rank_ic_diagnostic.note: rank-IC t 3.1-5.3 for value variants BUT portfolio-alpha t (authoritative) fails post-2017 (long-only realized alpha != cross-sectional rank power)

ew_vs_capw.note: EW benchmark 'survival' is the small-cap tilt, not a wall-escape.

large_cap_decomposition.note: wall-escape판별: intangible adj must strengthen LARGE-cap value. It does not.
large_cap_decomposition.verdict: LARGE-cap intangible value PORT_t ~0.08 (dead); SMALL retains ~1.48. Value stays small-cap.

reclassification.interpretation: 0.987 cross-rank corr + LARGE-cap rank-shift ≈ -0.001 (NOT positive) => intangible adjustment does NOT reclassify mega-caps cheaper. Wall-escape mechanism absent at its root.

adversarial_tilt_sweep.note: forcing large-cap/intangible tilt worsens POST2017 cap-w PORT_t (monotone wrong direction)

data_caveats.rd_line_coverage: RandD separate line collapses post-2016 (has_rd frac post-2017 = 0.17); post-2017 leans on SG&A org-capital + on-balance IntangibleAssets
